items.difficulty_reason: Derived-categorical descent statement (statement 4384-4392, proof 4394-4565): the injective and bounded halves are complete two-citation arguments; the unbounded half - announced 'we urge the reader to skip this' - is in fact fully carried out with K-injective replacements, the simplicial resolution, both double complexes written term by term, and the product quasi-isomorphism promotion; no step is left to the reader. H3: 172-line proof spanning four chapters' machinery.
